<div style="text-align: justify;"> Analysis start with a question. In this study question was; what was the diffrence of preference on basis of sex in Presedential election of 1992 for costing vote in favor of three contesting candidates Clinton, Bush and Perto? Data set was used from [American National Election Studies](https://electionstudies.org/data-center/anes-time-series-cumulative-data-file/). Preceptor table was drawn keeping in view outcome variables. The code may be seen in index file. However, Preceptor table was as :

## Preceptor Table
 A tibble: 1,658 × 2
   sex    pres_vote
   <chr>  <fct>    
 1 Female Bush     
 2 Female Bush     
 3 Female Clinton  
 4 Male   Bush     
 5 Female Clinton  
 6 Female Clinton  
 7 Female Perot    
 8 Male   Bush     
 9 Female Bush     
10 Male   Perot    
# ℹ 1,648 more rows

## Population
Population is the whole number of eligable voters in USA for Presidential election of 1992.

## Models
The relationship between probability family and mathematical model was built by using AI tool. Since, this analysis was having more than two outcome variable therefore, multinominal logistic regression and mathematical model was built up as:
</div> 

## Multinomial logistic regression is as under
$$
P(Y = k) = \rho_k = \frac{e^{\beta_{k0} + \beta_{k1} X_1 + \beta_{k2} X_2 + \cdots + \beta_{kn} X_n}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K} e^{\beta_{j0} + \beta_{j1} X_1 + \beta_{j2} X_2 + \cdots + \beta_{jn} X_n}}
$$


##  Mathematical model is as under
$$
Y \sim \text{Multinomial}(\boldsymbol{\rho}), \quad \text{where } \boldsymbol{\rho} = (\rho_1, \rho_2, \ldots, \rho_K)
$$

<div style="text-align: justify;"> The coefficients were drawn for parameters and fitted multinominal logistic regression was also designed with help of AI.
</div>
## Fitted multinomial logistic regression is as under
$$
\begin{aligned}
\hat{\rho}_{clinton} &= \frac{e^{0.45 - 0.25 \cdot male}}{1 + e^{0.45 - 0.25 \cdot male} + e^{-0.85 + 0.42 \cdot male}} \\
\hat{\rho}_{perot}   &= \frac{e^{-0.85 + 0.42 \cdot male}}{1 + e^{0.45 - 0.25 \cdot male} + e^{-0.85 + 0.42 \cdot male}} \\
\hat{\rho}_{bush}    &= \frac{1}{1 + e^{0.45 - 0.25 \cdot male} + e^{-0.85 + 0.42 \cdot male}}
\end{aligned}
$$
